name: tequila/k8schema
description: PHP class definitions of Kubernetes API resources

scripts.tools:install: test "$COMPOSER_DEV_MODE" = 0 || (composer install -d tools/php-cs-fixer --no-interaction --no-progress && composer install -d tools/k8schema-generator --no-interaction --no-progress)
scripts.tools:update: composer update -d tools/php-cs-fixer --no-scripts && composer update -d tools/k8schema-generator --no-scripts

scripts-descriptions.tools:install: Install the dev tools (php-cs-fixer, k8schema-generator) from their committed locks — runs after composer install/update, skipped under --no-dev
scripts-descriptions.tools:update: Update the dev tools to their newest versions and rewrite their locks (then re-run the checks and commit the locks)
